note: Vectors for spec/dossier-v1.md §11. Every case starts from the real testnet dossier fixtures/dossier/testnet-dossier.json and the raw transactions fixtures/testnet/<txid>.hex. It applies `patch` (RFC 6902 operations; '/claims/-' appends) and optionally changes the transactions supplied: `txs.omit` not supplied; `txs.mempool` reported in the mempool ('all' for every one); `txs.hex` replaces a transaction's hex. It checks with `expect_nonce` when given. Transactions from files have no height, so every claim that verifies also carries the detail that inclusion was not checked. `run: cli` cases were recorded with `target/debug/zeceipt dossier verify <file> --raw-tx-dir <dir> [--expect-nonce N]` (`exit` is its exit code); `run: checkDossier` cases with @zeceipt/verify checkDossier(text, { txs, expectNonce }) on the rebuilt WASM. Conformance is the statuses, nk_proven, controlled and parse errors; summaries are zeceipt's English, recorded for orientation. Recorded 2026-09-30 on the working tree after 2b54a10 (the review fixes, not yet committed).

nullifier_key_filler.ak_is: the spend validating key of the Orchard spending key 0x07 repeated 32 times
nullifier_key_filler.rivk: the integer t+1 (32 bytes little-endian) for the first t in 0..7 that makes a valid full viewing key

notes_note: From the live report of 2026-09-30 (testnet.zec.rocks). nullifier = DeriveNullifier_nk(note), computed from nk and the note opening alone; spent_in is the dossier's transaction whose actions carry that nullifier (absent: spent in none of them, so the note is not shown to be the holder's).
